entities.summary: Sondre Lerche (b. 1982-09-05, Bergen) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Bergen and Norway. Known in the fields of norway, composers & musicians, europe.
